text: In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1xi should be equal to Sl.No. 5xii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1xii should be equal to Sl.No. 5xiii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1xiii should be equal to Sl.No. 5xiv of schedule CYLA

In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 2xiii should be equal to Sl.No. 10(xviii ) of CFL
The amount of adjustment mentioned in CFL is not equal to amount of adjustment in BFLA. 36
In Schedule BFLA, brought forward business loss as per Sl.No. 2(iii) and brought forward depreciation as per Sl. No. 3(iii) cannot be set off against the 44BB & 44BBD income
In Schedule BFLA sum of column no 2 + 3 + 4 should not exceed amount as referred in column 1
In Schedule BFLA, Col No. 5 "Current year’s Income remaining after set off" should be equal to the output of Col No. 1-2-3-4
In Schedule BFLA, amount mentioned at Sl.No.5 should not exceed the amount mentioned at Sl.No.1
Schedule BFLA, amount mentioned at Sl. No. 2(xvi) should not exceed the sum of amount mentioned at Sl no. 4xviii+5cxviii+6xviii+7xviii+8xviii +9xviii+10xviii+11xviii of CFL
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1vi should be equal to Sl.No. 5vii of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1x should be equal to Sl.No. 5xi of schedule CYLA
In Schedule BFLA, Sl.No. 1vi should be equal to Sl.No. 5vii of schedule CYLA
Short Term Capital Loss at Schedule CFL" should be equal to sum of "Short Term Capital Losses remaining after set off" at table E of Schedule CG.
Long Term Capital Loss at Schedule CFL should be equal to sum of "Long Term Capital Losses remaining after set off" at table E of Schedule CG.
House Property Loss at Schedule CFL should be equal to the amount at "House Property Loss remaining after set-off at Schedule CYLA".
Business & Profession Loss (other than loss from speculative business and specified business ) at Schedule CFL should be equal to the amount at "Business & Profession Loss
remaining after set-off at Schedule CYLA" Other sources loss at Schedule CFL should be equal to the amount at "Other Sources Loss remaining after set-off at Schedule CYLA".
If "New Tax Regime" is not selected and in schedule CFL, Sl. No. 5b Amount as adjusted on account of opting for taxation u/s 115BAC should not be more than zero
In Schedule CFL, SL. No. 5c should be equal to 5a - 5b
Total of brought forward losses should be equal to amount provided in individual AYs
In Schedule CFL, value at sl.no.xx should be equal to xvii-xviii+xix. If result is negative, restrict to "0"
If "New Tax Regime" is not selected and In schedule UD, Sl. No. 3a Amount as adjusted on account of opting for taxation u/s 115BAC should not be more than zero
In Schedule UD, value at Sl.No. 4 cannot be more than Sl.No. 3- Sl.No.3a in any of the row
In Schedule UD, value at Sl.No.5 should be equal to Sl.No. 3- 3a - 4
In Schedule UD, value at sl.no.8 should be equal to sl.no. 6 - Sl. No. 7 37
In Schedule UD, sum of individual row should match with value at total fields for all columns i.e. column 3 to 8
In Schedule UD, value at Sl. No. 5 for current assessment year should not exceed the value mentioned at Sl. No. 12iii of Schedule BP
In Schedule ICDS, Sl.No. XI should be equal to the sum of (I+II+III+IV+V+VI+VII+VIII+IX+X)
In Schedule ICDS, Sl.No. 5 - "Net Effect" should be equal to Sl.No. 3 (Increase in profit) Less Sl.No. 4 (Decrease in profit).
In Schedule 10AA, value at field "Total deduction under section 10AA" should be equal to sum of column "Amount of deduction"
Schedule 10AA should be blank if "New Tax Regime" is selected
In Schedule 80G, amount of deduction computed should not be more than the eligible amount
Deduction u/s 80G is not allowed for donation made in cash above Rs. 2,000/- at Sl.No. A against one donee PAN.
Deduction u/s 80G is not allowed for donation made in cash above Rs. 2,000/- at Sl.No. B against one donee PAN.
Deduction u/s 80G is not allowed for donation made in cash above Rs. 2,000/- at Sl.No. C against one donee PAN.
Deduction u/s 80G is not allowed for donation made in cash above Rs. 2,000/- at Sl.No. D against one donee PAN.
in Schedule 80G, Total Donation at point A should be equal to the sum of Donation in Cash and Donation in other mode
in Schedule 80G, Total Donation at point B should be equal to the sum of Donation in Cash and Donation in other mode
in Schedule 80G, Total Donation at point C should be equal to the sum of Donation in Cash and Donation in other mode
in Schedule 80G, Total Donation at point D should be equal to the sum of Donation in Cash and Donation in other mode
In Sch 80G, Total Donation at point E should be equal to the sum of (Aix+Bix+Cix+Dx)
If deduction u/s 80G is claimed in Sch VIA then details should be provided in Schedule 80G
In schedule 80G, If PAN is already entered in anyone of the set of blocks (i.e. 100%, 50%,with Qualifying limit, without Qualifying limit) then same PAN cannot be entered in
any other block Schedule 80G should be blank if "New Tax Regime" is selected 38
Transaction Reference number for UPI transfer / Cheque number/ IMPS/ NEFT/ RTGS reference number and/ or IFSC code of Bank should be filled for all entries of
"contribution in other mode" in Schedule 80G PAN of donee shall be mandatory in case donation amount is more than 0 in schedule 80G
